title: FOUNDLING / FOUND MATTER CHARACTER
core_formula: found matter -> shape recognition -> minimal intervention -> character -> collectible artwork
core_lesson: FIND THE FORM BEFORE YOU MAKE THE FORM.
summary: Found stones become a character-based framed art object by observing latent form in the material and adding only minimal drawn intervention.
learn: Ask what the material already suggests before trying to transform it.
Look for latent form before fabrication.
Add only what is missing for recognition.
Natural variation can become product value.
A found object can sit between image, relief, collage and sculpture.
Minimal intervention can produce strong transformation.
avoid: rabbit-like characters as a default answer
round head plus oval body as a fixed recipe
exact drawn face, whiskers, paws, or curled tail
beige paper and dark frame as mandatory styling
cute characters as the only emotional mode
framed wall pieces as the only output format
failure_modes: forcing arbitrary stones into a pre-decided character instead of reading the material
too much drawing, paint, or decoration overwhelms the found matter
the intervention becomes craft clutter instead of minimal completion
the stones stop feeling unique and natural variation is lost
the result looks like a generic kids craft rather than a collectible object
the frame and background styling overpower the material discovery
source: user-provided concept text + 3 images for CONCEPT 07
